senses.exampleCN: 峡谷岩壁记录着数百万年的岩层。
senses.why: The noun simply marks which part or feature of the landform is meant.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词只是标出所指的是地貌的哪个部分或特征。

senses.title: A canyon-like landform type
senses.definition: a class of landform in geology, defined by depth, wall steepness and narrow floor
senses.definitionCN: 地质学中按深度、壁陡度与窄谷底定义的一类地貌
senses.example: The survey mapped every canyon in the basin.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查标出了盆地内每一条峡谷。
senses.why: Science turns the everyday word into a measurable category with thresholds.
senses.whyCN: 科学把这个日常词变成带有阈值的可测量类别。

intro.en: Canyon is an American Spanish loan from cañón 'tube, gorge', built on Latin canna 'reed'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: canyon 借自美洲西班牙语 cañón「管、峡」，后者由拉丁 canna「芦苇」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin canna meant 'reed, cane' and, by extension, anything tube-like; it is a borrowing from Greek kanna, itself probably from an Asian source.
items.cn: 拉丁 canna 意为「芦苇、茎」，引申指任何管状物；它借自希腊语 kanna，而后者可能又来自亚洲某语言。

items.en: Spanish caño meant 'tube, pipe, channel'; the augmentative cañón named a large tube or a deep narrow passage.
items.cn: 西班牙语 caño 意为「管、管道、水道」；增大的形式 cañón 指大管子或深窄通道。

items.en: In the southwestern Spanish-speaking world cañón was applied to the deep river-cut valleys of the region, adding the landscape sense.
items.cn: 在西南部讲西班牙语的地区，cañón 被用于当地由河流切出的深谷，从而增添了地貌义。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century, first in accounts of expeditions in the American West.
items.cn: 英语在 19 世纪借入这个词，最早出现在对美国西部考察的记述中。

items.en: The submarine sense is twentieth-century oceanography; the urban sense comes from city climate studies after tall buildings changed street wind patterns.
items.cn: 海底义属于 20 世纪的海洋学；城市义来自高楼改变街道风况之后的城市气候研究。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the Spanish-to-English date is approximate, and the pre-Latin origin of Greek kanna cannot be established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：从西班牙语进入英语的年代为约数，希腊 kanna 在拉丁语之前的来源无法确立。

note.en: The first group holds words that differ from canyon by one or two letters; the second holds words for narrow steep valleys.
note.cn: 第一组是与 canyon 差一两个字母的词；第二组是表示狭窄陡壁谷地的词。

entries.definition: A rule, or an accepted list of texts; it ends in -on, with no y, and comes from Greek kanōn 'rule'.
entries.definitionCN: 规则，或被认可的一组文本；结尾是 -on，没有 y，来自希腊 kanōn「规则」。

entries.definition: A large gun; it has a doubled n and comes through French from Italian cannone 'large tube'.
entries.definitionCN: 大炮；有双写 n，经法语来自意大利 cannone「大管子」。

entries.definition: The plural of canyon; the -s marks number, not a new word.
entries.definitionCN: canyon 的复数；-s 标记数量，不是新词。

entries.definition: A common misspelling that adds an r; it is not an English word.
entries.definitionCN: 常见误拼，多了一个 r；它不是英语词。

entries.definition: A narrow steep valley, often with a river; it is usually narrower than a canyon and less associated with dry country.
entries.definitionCN: 狭窄陡壁的谷，常有河流；通常比峡谷更窄，也不那么常与干旱地区联系。

entries.definition: Low land between high sides; it is broad and gently sloping, while a canyon is narrow with steep walls.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧高地之间的低地；宽阔而坡缓，而峡谷窄且壁陡。

entries.definition: A small deep valley worn by running water; it is much smaller than a canyon and usually has soil slopes.
entries.definitionCN: 由流水冲蚀的小深谷；比峡谷小得多，坡面通常是土。

entries.definition: A deep opening in the earth, often with vertical sides; it stresses the void and the drop rather than a valley floor.
entries.definitionCN: 地面上的深裂口，常为垂直壁；强调空洞与落差，而非谷底。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Spanish route, the real compounds and the modern technical senses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的西班牙语路径、真实的复合词与现代技术义。

normal.en: Latin canna 'reed' gives Spanish caño 'tube', then cañón 'large tube'.
normal.cn: 拉丁 canna「芦苇」给出西班牙语 caño「管」，再成为 cañón「大管子」。

normal.en: The family runs canyon, canyons, canyon wall, canyon floor, canyon rim.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 canyon、canyons、canyon wall、canyon floor、canyon rim。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: deep canyon, canyon rim, submarine canyon, urban canyon.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 deep canyon、canyon rim、submarine canyon、urban canyon。

normal.en: A canyon is measured by depth and wall steepness, not by length.
normal.cn: 峡谷用深度与壁陡度衡量，而不是长度。

normal.en: A valley opens; a canyon cuts. The difference is the wall.
normal.cn: 山谷是敞开的，峡谷是切开的；差别就在那面壁。

abstract.en: Picture a knife cutting straight down through many coloured layers of cake.
abstract.cn: 想象一把刀垂直切穿许多层颜色分明的蛋糕。

abstract.en: Picture two glass walls so close that the sky becomes a narrow strip.
abstract.cn: 想象两面玻璃墙靠得很近，天空缩成一条窄缝。

abstract.en: Picture two people on opposite rims who can see each other but cannot reach each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人站在对面的崖缘，能看见彼此却走不到一起。

examples.en: The river has cut the canyon deeper by a few centimetres each century.
examples.cn: 这条河每个世纪都把峡谷再切深几厘米。

examples.en: Hikers must carry water because the canyon floor is much hotter than the rim.
examples.cn: 徒步者必须带水，因为谷底比崖缘热得多。

examples.en: The street forms an urban canyon that blocks the evening breeze.
examples.cn: 这条街形成一条城市峡谷，挡住了傍晚的微风。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「看（kan）+ 甬（yon）」—— 往下看，只见一条像甬道的深窄石缝 → 峡谷

root: 美洲西班牙语 cañón「大管子、深峡」← 西班牙语 caño「管」← 拉丁 canna「芦苇、茎」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all keep one geometry: a narrow slot with steep walls, cut by water, by cities or by disagreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一种几何：一条两壁陡直的窄缝，由水、城市或分歧切出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deep vertical slot cut into layered rock, with two nearly parallel walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：在层状岩层中切出的深竖缝，两侧岩壁几乎平行。

branches.en: THE LANDFORM: the river-cut slot, the district it defines and the geological class.
branches.cn: 地貌：河流切出的窄缝、它定义的地区以及地质类别。

branches.en: UNDER WATER: the same slot forms on the continental slope.
branches.cn: 水下：同样的窄缝在大陆坡上形成。

branches.en: BUILT WALLS: streets and rock passages reproduce the geometry.
branches.cn: 人造的壁：街道与岩缝复制了这种几何。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: a deep gap in ground becomes a deep gap between positions.
branches.cn: 比喻：地面的深缝变成立场之间的深缝。

branches.en: THE PARTS: walls, rim and floor are named by the noun in attributive use.
branches.cn: 各个部分：壁、崖缘与谷底由该名词的定语用法命名。

intro.en: Canyon is a Spanish loan with a clear Latin base; English builds compounds on it rather than suffixes.
intro.cn: canyon 是西班牙语借词，拉丁基础清晰；英语主要在它上面造复合词，而非后缀派生。

latinIntro.en: Latin canna 'reed' underlies Spanish caño and cañón; Latin canalis 'channel' is a related derivative of the same stem, which is why canal appears in the wider family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 canna「芦苇」是西班牙语 caño 与 cañón 的基础；拉丁 canalis「水道」是同词干的相关派生词，这就是 canal 出现在更广词族中的原因。

items.structure: American Spanish cañón, from caño 'tube', from Latin canna
items.example: The canyon runs for fifty kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 这条峡谷延伸五十公里。

items.example: Three canyons open onto the plateau.
items.exampleCN: 三条峡谷通向高原。

items.meaning: the steep side of a canyon
items.example: The canyon wall shows red layers.
items.exampleCN: 峡谷岩壁露出红色岩层。

items.example: The canyon floor is hot at midday.
items.exampleCN: 正午谷底很热。

items.meaning: the top edge of a canyon
items.example: We stood on the canyon rim.
items.exampleCN: 我们站在峡谷崖缘上。

items.example: The submarine canyon feeds a fan of sediment.
items.exampleCN: 这条海底峡谷供给一片沉积扇。

items.example: The urban canyon limits air flow.
items.exampleCN: 城市峡谷限制了空气流动。

items.example: Canyonlands cover most of the park.
items.exampleCN: 峡谷地貌占了公园的大部分。

items.example: The Latin word named a hollow stem.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词指中空的茎。

latinEntries.structure: canalis, canalis (m., third declension, from canna)

definition_zh: 峡谷；咽喉；狼吞虎咽；塞饱；冰塞；作呕感
definition_en: a narrow steep valley; the throat; to eat greedily; a blockage of ice in a river; a feeling of disgust
core_image: 两壁夹得极近的一条深缝，中间只容一条水线通过
scene: 两壁几乎贴在一起，河在下方发出很响的水声。The gorge narrows until the two walls almost touch.
sceneCN: 此处指「两壁陡直、宽度极小的峡谷」（第 1 个义项：窄到几乎只剩一条水道的深谷）；句意为这条峡谷越收越窄，直到两壁几乎相贴。图中可辨识物件：几乎相接的岩壁、下方湍急的水线、回声、狭窄的天空。

pos.zh: 峡谷；咽喉；作呕感；阻塞物（如冰塞）
狼吞虎咽地吃；塞满；在石料上开凹槽
贪婪地吃（gorge on）

derivatives.zh: 华丽的；极美的（与本词关系不确定）

senses.title: A narrow steep valley
senses.definition: a narrow valley with steep rocky sides, usually with a river at the bottom
senses.definitionCN: 两侧陡峭、底部常有河流的狭窄山谷
senses.example: The gorge narrows until the two walls almost touch.
senses.exampleCN: 这条峡谷越收越窄，直到两壁几乎相贴。
senses.why: The word first meant throat; a landscape that squeezes tight like a throat borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指咽喉；像咽喉一样收得极紧的地形就借用了这个名字。

senses.title: The throat
senses.definition: the passage at the back of the mouth, in older or medical-style use
senses.definitionCN: 口腔后部的通道，用于较古或医学风格的表述
senses.example: Cold water eased the heat in his gorge.
senses.exampleCN: 凉水缓解了他咽喉里的燥热。
senses.why: The body part is the oldest sense: a narrow tube through which everything swallowed must pass.
senses.whyCN: 身体部位是最早的义项：一根狭窄的管子，所有吞下的东西都必须经过。

senses.title: To eat greedily
senses.definition: to eat large amounts quickly and without restraint
senses.definitionCN: 快速而无节制地吃下大量食物
senses.example: The children gorged on cake at the party.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在聚会上猛吃蛋糕。
senses.why: Stuffing the throat to its limit turns the body-part noun into a verb of overfilling.
senses.whyCN: 把咽喉塞到极限，就把这个身体部位名词变成了「塞满」的动词。

senses.title: To fill something to excess
senses.definition: to fill a space or a person beyond what is needed
senses.definitionCN: 把空间或人填到超出所需
senses.example: Rain had gorged the ditches along the road.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水把路边的沟渠灌得满满的。
senses.why: The throat image extends to any channel that can be packed full and stop flowing.
senses.whyCN: 咽喉意象扩展到任何能被塞满并停止流动的通道。

senses.title: An ice blockage in a river
senses.definition: a mass of ice that blocks a narrow river channel and can cause flooding
senses.definitionCN: 堵塞狭窄河道、可能引发洪水的冰块堆积
senses.example: An ice gorge formed where the river bends.
senses.exampleCN: 河流转弯处形成了一道冰塞。
senses.why: A narrow channel plus a total blockage reproduces the throat that cannot pass anything.
senses.whyCN: 狭窄通道加上彻底堵塞，正好复制了什么都通不过的咽喉。

senses.title: A feeling of disgust
senses.definition: a rising feeling of nausea or strong dislike
senses.definitionCN: 上涌的恶心感或强烈厌恶
senses.example: The sight made his gorge rise.
senses.exampleCN: 那景象让他一阵作呕。
senses.why: Disgust is felt in the throat; the body-part noun names the physical sensation itself.
senses.whyCN: 厌恶感在咽喉处被感觉到；这个身体部位名词就直接命名了那种生理感受。

senses.title: A hollow moulding in stone
senses.definition: a concave curved moulding cut into stone or wood
senses.definitionCN: 在石材或木材上切出的凹圆线脚
senses.example: The mason cut a gorge along the base of the column.
senses.exampleCN: 石匠在柱基上切出一道凹圆线脚。
senses.why: A concave groove is a throat in the material: narrow, deep and hollowed out.
senses.whyCN: 凹形沟槽就是材料上的咽喉：窄、深、被掏空。

senses.title: To cut a groove into stone
senses.definition: to channel or hollow out a edge of stone or wood
senses.definitionCN: 在石材或木材的边缘开槽或掏空
senses.example: Workers gorged the edge before fitting the panel.
senses.exampleCN: 工人在安装面板前先给边缘开槽。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of making the shape, just as many tool and form words do.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为「造出该形状」的动词，许多工具词与形状词都这样变化。

intro.en: Gorge came from Old French for 'throat' and goes back to Late Latin gurga, probably connected with Latin gurges 'whirlpool'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: gorge 来自古法语「咽喉」，上溯至晚期拉丁 gurga，可能与拉丁 gurges「漩涡」有关。年代均为约数。

items.en: Late Latin gurga meant 'throat'; it is usually taken as a variant of Latin gurges 'whirlpool, gullet', though the two forms are not fully explained.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 gurga 意为「咽喉」；通常被视为拉丁 gurges「漩涡、食道」的变体，但两种形式之间的关系并未完全说清。

items.en: Latin gurges, gurgitis named a swirling mass of water and, by transfer, the throat; the link is the idea of a channel that draws things down.
items.cn: 拉丁 gurges、gurgitis 指旋转的水体，又转指咽喉；联系在于「把东西往下吸的通道」这一意象。

items.en: Old French gorge meant 'throat, neck, bosom' and also 'a narrow pass'; both the body sense and the landscape sense already coexisted.
items.cn: 古法语 gorge 指「咽喉、颈、胸前」，也指「狭窄通道」；身体义与地貌义当时已经并存。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the fourteenth century; the 'narrow valley' sense developed from the image of a pass that squeezes like a throat.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪借入这个词；「窄谷」义由「像咽喉一样收紧的通道」这一意象发展而来。

items.en: The verb 'to eat greedily' and the idiom 'make one's gorge rise' both grow from the throat sense in the later Middle Ages.
items.cn: 动词「贪婪地吃」与习语「令人作呕」都从中古英语后期的咽喉义生长出来。

items.en: Source uncertain (root): the pre-Latin origin of gurges is debated, and no single Indo-European form is agreed; the dates given are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根）：gurges 在拉丁语之前的来源有争议，没有公认的单一印欧形式；所给年代为约数。

note.en: The first group holds words that look or sound like gorge; the second holds words for narrow valleys and throats.
note.cn: 第一组是形近或音近的词；第二组是表示窄谷与咽喉的词。

entries.definition: Extremely beautiful or fine; it may go back to Old French gorgias, of uncertain link to gorge, so it is not used here as a derivative of the valley sense.
entries.definitionCN: 极美的、华丽的；可能来自古法语 gorgias，与 gorge 的关联不确定，因此这里不把它当作山谷义的派生词。

entries.definition: To cut or scoop out with a tool; the vowel is /aʊ/, not /ɔː/.
entries.definitionCN: 用工具凿出或挖出；元音是 /aʊ/ 而非 /ɔː/。

entries.definition: A spiny yellow-flowered shrub; it ends in -se and has nothing to do with valleys.
entries.definitionCN: 一种带刺、开黄花的灌木；以 -se 结尾，与山谷无关。

entries.definition: The plural of the noun or the third person of the verb; the -s marks grammar, not a new word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词复数或动词第三人称；-s 标记语法，不是新词。

entries.definition: A deep valley with steep walls, often in dry country; it is usually wider than a gorge and more strongly associated with river cutting.
entries.definitionCN: 常位于干旱地区的深陡峡谷；通常比 gorge 宽，也更强调河流切割。

entries.definition: A small deep valley cut by water; it is much smaller than a gorge and often has soil rather than rock walls.
entries.definitionCN: 由水切出的小深谷；比 gorge 小得多，壁多为土而非岩石。

entries.definition: A deep gap with vertical sides; it stresses the drop and the emptiness rather than a passable channel.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧垂直的深裂口；强调落差与空洞，而非可通行的通道。

entries.definition: The ordinary English word for the passage at the back of the mouth; gorge is its older, more literary counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 指口腔后部通道的普通英语词；gorge 是它较古、较文学化的对应词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real throat sense, the real idioms and the real compounds.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的咽喉义、真实的习语与真实的复合词。

normal.en: The throat image runs through the whole family: narrow, deep, hard to pass.
normal.cn: 咽喉意象贯穿整个词族：窄、深、难以通过。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: narrow gorge, deep gorge, ice gorge, through the gorge.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 narrow gorge、deep gorge、ice gorge、through the gorge。

normal.en: The idiom the gorge rises keeps the physical feeling of nausea in the throat.
normal.cn: 习语 the gorge rises 保留了恶心的生理感觉，位置就在咽喉。

normal.en: To gorge on food is to fill the throat until nothing more can pass.
normal.cn: gorge on food 就是把咽喉填满，直到再也通不过任何东西。

normal.en: Compare canyon: a canyon is wide enough to stand in; a gorge is tight enough to echo.
normal.cn: 对比 canyon：峡谷宽到可以站人；gorge 窄到会产生回声。

abstract.en: Picture a funnel squeezed so hard that only a thread of water gets through.
abstract.cn: 想象一个漏斗被夹得极紧，只有一丝水能通过。

abstract.en: Picture a meal eaten so fast that the eater never tastes it.
abstract.cn: 想象一顿饭吃得太快，吃的人根本没尝到味道。

abstract.en: Picture a river blocked by ice until the water behind it rises.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河被冰堵住，后面的水于是上涨。

examples.en: The path follows the river through a narrow gorge.
examples.cn: 这条小径沿河穿过一道狭窄的峡谷。

examples.en: He gorged himself on fruit after the long fast.
examples.cn: 长时间禁食之后，他猛吃水果。

examples.en: An ice gorge blocked the river and flooded the lower fields.
examples.cn: 一道冰塞堵住了河道，淹了下游的田地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「割（ge）+ 只（orge）」—— 两壁像被割开，只留一条窄缝 → 峡谷；咽喉

root: 古法语 gorge「咽喉、狭窄通道」← 晚期拉丁 gurga，可能与拉丁 gurges「漩涡、食道」有关；更深词根存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all come from a throat: a narrow valley, the body passage, greedy eating, overfilling, an ice blockage, nausea, a hollow moulding and the act of cutting one.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都出自「咽喉」：窄谷、身体通道、贪婪进食、填塞过量、冰堵、恶心、凹线脚，以及开槽的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow tube that everything must pass through, and that can be blocked or stuffed.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根所有东西都必须通过的窄管，它会堵，也会被塞满。

branches.en: THE NARROW CHANNEL: a valley squeezed like a throat, and the act of cutting such a groove.
branches.cn: 窄通道：像咽喉一样被夹紧的谷，以及切出这种凹槽的动作。

branches.en: THE BODY: the passage itself and the nausea felt inside it.
branches.cn: 身体：通道本身，以及在通道里感到的恶心。

branches.en: STUFFING: eating fast and filling any container past its limit.
branches.cn: 塞满：快速进食，以及把任何容器填过极限。

branches.en: THE BLOCKED PASS: ice turns a narrow channel into a dam.
branches.cn: 被堵的通道：冰把窄通道变成一道坝。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL GROOVE: stone and wood repeat the hollow throat shape.
branches.cn: 材料上的槽：石材与木材重复了中空咽喉的形状。

intro.en: Gorge is a French loan with a small English family; the connection to gorgeous is uncertain and is flagged rather than assumed.
intro.cn: gorge 是法语借词，英语词族不大；它与 gorgeous 的关联不确定，此处标明而非假定。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin gurga and Latin gurges supply the likely base; the pre-Latin origin is disputed, so the deeper Indo-European layer remains a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁 gurga 与拉丁 gurges 提供可能的基底；拉丁语之前的来源有争议，更深的印欧层次仍属重构。

items.structure: Old French gorge 'throat', from Late Latin gurga
items.example: The gorge carries meltwater in spring.
items.exampleCN: 春天这条峡谷输送融水。

items.meaning: more than one gorge; he, she or it gorges
items.example: Two gorges join above the lake.
items.exampleCN: 两条峡谷在湖上方汇合。

items.example: The stream was gorged with storm water.
items.exampleCN: 小溪被暴雨水灌满了。

items.example: Gorging on sugar is bad for the teeth.
items.exampleCN: 猛吃糖对牙齿有害。

items.example: The gorger finished the whole plate alone.
items.exampleCN: 这个贪吃的人独自吃完了整盘。

items.structure: Old French gorgias, link to gorge uncertain
items.example: The valley looked gorgeous at sunset.
items.exampleCN: 日落时这条山谷美极了。

items.meaning: an ice blockage in a narrow river
items.example: The ice gorge broke up in March.
items.exampleCN: 冰塞在三月份解开了。

items.meaning: a trail running through a gorge
items.example: The gorge path is closed after heavy rain.
items.exampleCN: 大雨之后峡谷小径封闭。

latinEntries.structure: gurga, gurgae (f., Late Latin, first declension)

definition_zh: 高原；台地；平台期；平稳阶段；托盘
definition_en: a large area of high flat land; a period when progress stops rising; a flat tray or dish
core_image: 地面被整体抬高之后，顶部留出一大片几乎水平的平面，边缘却突然下落
scene: 车爬上长坡之后，眼前忽然展开一片望不到边的平地。After the long climb the road crosses a wide plateau.
sceneCN: 此处指「被整体抬升、顶部平坦的大片高地」（第 1 个义项：海拔高而表面近乎水平的大区域）；句意为爬完长坡之后，公路穿过一片宽阔的高原。图中可辨识物件：长坡、水平的地平线、突然下落的边缘、稀疏植被。

pos.zh: 高原；台地；平台期；平稳阶段；托盘
趋于平稳；进入平台期
高原的；平台期的（如 plateau phase）

derivatives.zh: 高原（复数）；（他、她、它）趋于平稳

senses.title: A large high flat area
senses.definition: an extensive area of land raised well above its surroundings and mostly flat on top
senses.definitionCN: 高出周围、顶部大体平坦的大片陆地
senses.example: After the long climb the road crosses a wide plateau.
senses.exampleCN: 爬完长坡之后，公路穿过一片宽阔的高原。
senses.why: French plat meant 'flat', and the diminutive plateau named a flat raised surface; geography kept the flatness and the height.
senses.whyCN: 法语 plat 意为「平的」，指小形式指平坦的抬高面；地理学保留了「平」与「高」两点。

senses.title: A small tableland or mesa
senses.definition: a smaller flat-topped elevated area with steep edges
senses.definitionCN: 边缘陡峭、顶部平坦的较小高地
senses.example: The village sits on a low plateau above the river.
senses.exampleCN: 村子坐落在河上方的一块低台地上。
senses.why: The form comes in sizes: a mesa is the small version of the same flat-topped shape.
senses.whyCN: 这种形状有大小之分：台地就是同一种平顶形状的小型版本。

senses.title: A learning plateau
senses.definition: a stage in learning when improvement seems to stop for a time
senses.definitionCN: 学习中进步暂时看似停止的阶段
senses.example: Most learners hit a plateau after the first few months.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数学习者在最初几个月后都会遇到平台期。
senses.why: A rising curve that turns flat looks like a plateau: progress continues sideways instead of upward.
senses.whyCN: 上升的曲线转为水平，看起来就像高原：进步横向延伸而不再向上。

senses.title: A period of stable performance
senses.titleCN: 表现平稳期；增长停滞期
senses.definition: a period when performance or growth stays level rather than rising
senses.definitionCN: 表现或增长保持水平而不再上升的时期
senses.example: Sales reached a plateau in the second half of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 销量在下半年进入平稳期。
senses.why: Business graphs reuse the landform: a flat stretch between two rises is read as a plateau.
senses.whyCN: 商业图表沿用这个地貌：两段上升之间的平坦段被读成高原。

senses.title: The flat section of a graph
senses.definition: the horizontal portion of a curve where the value does not change
senses.definitionCN: 曲线上数值不变的水平部分
senses.example: The dose-response curve shows a clear plateau.
senses.exampleCN: 剂量反应曲线出现明显的平台段。
senses.why: Mathematics names the horizontal stretch after the shape it resembles.
senses.whyCN: 数学根据所像的形状来命名那段水平区间。

senses.title: A raised flat-top structure
senses.definition: an elevated flat surface in a building, a stage or a machine
senses.definitionCN: 建筑、舞台或机器上的抬高平面
senses.example: The stage has a plateau where the chorus stands.
senses.exampleCN: 舞台有一块合唱队站立的平台。
senses.why: The word describes the shape wherever it occurs, not only in geography.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描述的是形状本身，出现在哪里都算，不只用于地理。

senses.title: To level off
senses.definition: to stop rising and stay at the same level
senses.definitionCN: 停止上升并保持在同一水平
senses.example: Demand plateaued after the price increase.
senses.exampleCN: 涨价之后需求趋于平稳。
senses.why: The noun became a verb: to plateau is to take on the flatness of the landform.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：这样用就是呈现出这种地貌的平坦。

senses.title: A flat serving tray
senses.definition: a flat dish or tray for carrying or displaying things, especially in French-style use
senses.definitionCN: 用来端送或陈列物品的平盘，尤见于法语风格用法
senses.example: The waiter set the plateau of cheeses on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 侍者把那盘奶酪放到桌上。
senses.why: The oldest French sense was a flat dish; English kept it as a decorative or serving term.
senses.whyCN: 最早的法语义就是平盘；英语把它保留为装饰或端送用的说法。

intro.en: Plateau is a French diminutive of plat 'flat', from Latin plattus, ultimately Greek platys 'broad, flat'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: plateau 是法语 plat「平的」的指小形式，源自拉丁 plattus，最终来自希腊 platys「宽而平」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek platys meant 'broad, flat'; it also underlies platysma and the geological term platform through other routes.
items.cn: 希腊 platys 意为「宽而平」；它也通过其他路径构成 platysma 与地质学术语 platform。

items.en: Latin plattus 'flat, broad' was a colloquial borrowing from Greek and passed into the Romance languages.
items.cn: 拉丁 plattus「平的、宽的」是来自希腊语的口语借词，随后进入罗曼语族。

items.en: French plat meant 'flat' and, as a noun, 'a flat dish'; the diminutive plateau first named a flat tray or platter.
items.cn: 法语 plat 意为「平的」，作名词指「平盘」；指小形式 plateau 最初指平托盘或大盘。

items.en: In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries travellers applied plateau to the flat highlands of interior continents, and the landform sense became dominant.
items.cn: 在 18 与 19 世纪，旅行者把 plateau 用于内陆的平坦高地，地貌义随后占据主导。

items.en: The 'period of no progress' sense is twentieth-century, borrowed from the flat stretch of a graph.
items.cn: 「停滞期」义属于 20 世纪，借自图表上的平坦段。

items.en: The main line is secure; only the first date of each sense is approximate. The pre-Greek origin of platys is not established, so deeper forms are reconstructions.
items.cn: 主要线索可靠，只有各义项的首见年代为约数。platys 在希腊语之前的来源尚未确立，更早的形式均属重构。

note.en: The first group holds words that share the plat- shape; the second holds landform words for high flat ground.
note.cn: 第一组是共享 plat- 形状的词；第二组是表示高而平坦地面的地貌词。

entries.definition: A flat dish or a flat sheet of metal; it comes from the same French plat family but has no raised-land sense.
entries.definitionCN: 平盘或金属平板；同出法语 plat 词族，但没有高地的意义。

entries.definition: A large flat dish for serving food; it is a dish word, not a landform word.
entries.definitionCN: 端送食物的大平盘；它是餐具词，不是地貌词。

entries.definition: A small military unit; it comes from French peloton, of different formation, and only looks as if it belongs here.
entries.definitionCN: 小型军事单位；来自法语 peloton，构词不同，只是看起来像同族。

entries.definition: The French-style plural of plateau; it is the same word in another number form.
entries.definitionCN: plateau 的法语式复数；只是同一个词的另一种数的形式。

entries.definition: A broad flat elevated region; the word says plainly what plateau says in French.
entries.definitionCN: 宽阔平坦的高地；这个词把 plateau 用法语表达的意思直接说了出来。

entries.definition: A flat-topped hill with steep sides, borrowed from Spanish 'table'; it is smaller than a plateau.
entries.definitionCN: 顶部平坦、侧壁陡峭的小山，借自西班牙语「桌子」；比高原小。

entries.definition: Land that is higher than the surrounding area, without the strong flatness that plateau requires.
entries.definitionCN: 高于周围地区的地面，但不强调 plateau 所要求的平坦。

entries.definition: Elevated country, usually hilly or mountainous; it is high but not necessarily flat.
entries.definitionCN: 抬高的地区，通常多丘或多山；它高，但不一定平。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real French flat word, the real graph metaphor and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的法语「平」词、真实的图表比喻与固定搭配。

normal.en: French plat 'flat' + -eau (diminutive): a flat raised surface.
normal.cn: 法语 plat「平的」+ -eau（指小）：一块抬高的平面。

normal.en: The family runs plateau, plateaus, plateaux, plateaued, plateauing.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 plateau、plateaus、plateaux、plateaued、plateauing。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: reach a plateau, plateau phase, learning plateau, high plateau.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 reach a plateau、plateau phase、learning plateau、high plateau。

normal.en: The landform and the graph share one shape: rise, flat, rise again.
normal.cn: 地貌与图表共享同一个形状：上升、变平、再上升。

normal.en: A plateau is high and flat; a mesa is the small version; a tableland is the plain English name.
normal.cn: plateau 高而平；mesa 是它的缩小版；tableland 是平实的英语名称。

abstract.en: Picture a table lifted a kilometre into the air, its top still level.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子被抬到一千米高空，桌面仍然水平。

abstract.en: Picture a climbing line that suddenly turns sideways and runs flat.
abstract.cn: 想象一条上升的线突然转向水平延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a plate held up by a thick stem of rock.
abstract.cn: 想象一只盘子被一根粗岩柱托起。

examples.en: The plateau is dry, windy and covered with short grass.
examples.cn: 这片高原干燥、多风，覆盖着矮草。

examples.en: Her running times plateaued after the injury.
examples.cn: 受伤之后，她的跑步成绩趋于平稳。

examples.en: After rapid growth, membership reached a plateau.
examples.cn: 会员人数在快速增长之后进入平台期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「平（pla）+ 托（teau）」—— 被高高托起却依然平的一大块地 → 高原；平台期

root: 法语 plateau（plat「平的」的指小形式）← 拉丁 plattus「平的」← 希腊 platys「宽而平」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe the same profile: something rises, then runs flat for a long stretch, whether that stretch is land, learning, sales, a graph, a stage or a tray.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项描述同一个轮廓：某物升起后在一段很长的距离上保持水平，无论这段是土地、学习、销量、图表、舞台还是托盘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised surface whose top stays level while its edges drop away.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块被抬高的表面，顶部保持水平，边缘却向下落。

branches.en: THE LAND: a broad high flat area and its smaller flat-topped cousin.
branches.cn: 土地：大片高而平的地区，以及它较小的平顶近亲。

branches.en: THE CURVE: learning, performance and graphs all go flat for a while.
branches.cn: 曲线：学习、表现与图表都会有一段时间走平。

branches.en: THE ACTION: to plateau is to take on that flat profile.
branches.cn: 动作：plateau 作动词就是呈现出这种平坦轮廓。

branches.en: THE BUILT FORM: a stage or platform repeats the shape.
branches.cn: 人造形态：舞台或平台重复了这一形状。

branches.en: THE OLD DISH: the French tray sense survives as a serving word.
branches.cn: 古老的盘子：法语的托盘义作为餐具词保留下来。

intro.en: Plateau is a French diminutive with two accepted plurals; English also made it a verb in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: plateau 是法语指小形式，有两种被接受的复数；英语在 20 世纪还把它用作动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin plattus 'flat' comes from Greek platys 'broad, flat'; the same Greek word underlies plate, platter and the geological platform through separate routes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 plattus「平的」来自希腊 platys「宽而平」；同一个希腊词通过不同路径也构成 plate、platter 与地质学术语 platform。

items.example: The plateau stretches for hundreds of kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 这片高原延伸数百公里。

items.meaning: more than one plateau; it levels off
items.example: Two plateaus lie east of the river.
items.exampleCN: 两片高原位于河东。

items.meaning: more than one plateau, in French-influenced style
items.example: The map marks three plateaux.
items.exampleCN: 地图标出了三片高原。

items.example: Growth plateaued last year.
items.exampleCN: 增长在去年趋于平稳。

items.example: Plateauing is common after early gains.
items.exampleCN: 早期收益之后出现平台期很常见。

items.example: The drug showed a plateau effect at high doses.
items.exampleCN: 这种药在高剂量时表现出平台效应。

items.meaning: a stage in which values stay level
items.example: The plateau phase lasted two weeks.
items.exampleCN: 平台阶段持续了两周。

items.meaning: a stage where learning slows to a stop
items.example: A learning plateau can be broken by new practice.
items.exampleCN: 换一种练习方式可以打破学习平台期。

items.example: The plate is wider than the tray.
items.exampleCN: 这只盘子比托盘宽。

latinEntries.structure: platea, plateae (f., first declension, from Greek plateia)

definition_zh: 平原；平地；朴素的；清楚的；直率的；简单的
definition_en: a large area of flat land; simple and without decoration; easy to understand; direct and honest
core_image: 一片没有任何起伏的地面，视线可以一直看到天边
scene: 风把草压成一片连续的低浪，地平线一直延伸到看不见的地方。A dry plain stretches beyond the last row of trees.
sceneCN: 此处指「广阔而平坦的陆地」（第 1 个义项：缺少起伏、视野开阔的大片低地）；句意为过了最后一排树，一片干燥的平原一直延伸出去。图中可辨识物件：压低的草浪、笔直的地平线、最后一排树、无起伏的地面。

pos.zh: 平原；平地；（复数）平原地区
朴素的；无装饰的；清楚的；直率的；简单的
（口语）完全地；简直（如 plain wrong）

senses.title: A large area of flat land
senses.definition: a broad area of land with little or no change in height
senses.definitionCN: 高度起伏很小或没有起伏的大片陆地
senses.example: A dry plain stretches beyond the last row of trees.
senses.exampleCN: 过了最后一排树，一片干燥的平原一直延伸出去。
senses.why: Latin planus meant 'flat, level'; the noun names ground that offers no rise to stop the eye.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 planus 意为「平的、水平的」；这个名词指不提供任何隆起阻挡视线的地方。

senses.title: Flat country in the plural
senses.definition: the plains, used for a whole region of flat open country
senses.definitionCN: 用复数指一整片平坦开阔的地区
senses.example: Storms move quickly across the plains.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴快速掠过这片平原地区。
senses.why: The plural turns a stretch of flat ground into a named region, as with the mountains.
senses.whyCN: 复数把一段平地变成一个有名字的地区，就像「山脉」一词的用法一样。

senses.title: Simple and undecorated
senses.definition: without ornament, pattern or unnecessary detail
senses.definitionCN: 没有装饰、花纹或不必要的细节
senses.example: She wore a plain grey dress to the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿了一件素灰色连衣裙去参加典礼。
senses.why: A surface with nothing added is metaphorically level: no raised ornament, no pattern.
senses.whyCN: 没有附加任何东西的表面在比喻上是「平的」：没有凸起的装饰，也没有花纹。

senses.title: Easy to understand
senses.definition: expressed so clearly that no explanation is needed
senses.definitionCN: 表达得足够清楚，无需再解释
senses.example: The instructions were written in plain English.
senses.exampleCN: 这些说明用平实的英语写成。
senses.why: Clear speech is flat ground: nothing in the way, no obstacle between meaning and listener.
senses.whyCN: 清楚的话就是平地：中间没有障碍，意思与听者之间没有阻隔。

senses.title: Direct and honest in speech
senses.definition: saying what is true without softening or hiding it
senses.definitionCN: 不加缓和、不加遮掩地说出真实情况
senses.example: He gave a plain answer that surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他给了一个直率的回答，让所有人都吃了一惊。
senses.why: Plainness removes cover: what is said is exactly what is meant, with no decorative evasion.
senses.whyCN: 朴素意味着去掉遮盖：说出来的就是本意，没有任何装饰性的回避。

senses.title: Ordinary in appearance
senses.definition: not beautiful or striking in face or style
senses.definitionCN: 面容或风格不出众、不引人注目
senses.example: He was a plain man with a quiet voice.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个相貌平常、声音安静的人。
senses.why: The same 'nothing added' idea applies to looks: no feature stands out.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「没有附加」的想法也用于外貌：没有哪个特征特别突出。

senses.title: Basic and unelaborate
senses.definition: simple in composition, as food or clothing with nothing extra
senses.definitionCN: 构成简单，如不加额外调料的食物或衣物
senses.example: They ate plain bread and cheese by the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在火边吃简单的面包和奶酪。
senses.why: Plain food has nothing added to it, so the adjective marks the absence of extras.
senses.whyCN: 这类食物就是没有额外添加的东西，因此这个形容词标记的是「没有附加」。

senses.title: Complete and obvious
senses.definition: used for emphasis to mean sheer or unmistakable
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调，表示纯粹的、显而易见的
senses.example: That is plain nonsense from beginning to end.
senses.exampleCN: 那从头到尾都是十足的胡扯。
senses.why: What is obvious needs no ornament or argument; the flat sense becomes an intensifier.
senses.whyCN: 显而易见的东西不需要装饰或论证；平坦义于是变成强调词。

intro.en: Plain the noun and plain the adjective come from the same Latin adjective planus 'flat'; the two uses merged in English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 名词 plain 与形容词 plain 都来自同一个拉丁形容词 planus「平的」；两种用法在英语中合并。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin planus meant 'flat, level, even' and, figuratively, 'clear, plain'; the neuter noun planum meant 'a flat surface'.
items.cn: 拉丁 planus 意为「平的、平的、均匀的」，引申为「清楚的、明白的」；中性名词 planum 指「平面」。

items.en: Planities 'level ground, plain' supplied the landscape noun; it is built on the same stem as planus.
items.cn: planities「平地、平原」提供了地貌名词，它与 planus 同词干。

items.en: Old French plain carried both the adjective 'flat, simple' and the noun 'flat country' into English.
items.cn: 古法语 plain 同时把形容词「平的、朴素的」与名词「平地」带进了英语。

items.en: Middle English kept both, and the adjective developed the senses 'clear', 'honest', 'ordinary' and 'simple' from the idea of having nothing added.
items.cn: 中古英语保留了两者；形容词从「没有附加」这一想法发展出「清楚」「直率」「平常」「简单」等义。

items.en: Fixed compounds such as flood plain, plain clothes and plain English settled in the modern period and mark the separate senses.
items.cn: flood plain、plain clothes、plain English 等固定复合词在近代固定下来，标出各自不同的义项。

items.en: The Latin layer is secure; only the first dates are approximate. Any deeper Indo-European source for planus is a reconstruction and is not asserted here.
items.cn: 拉丁层次可靠，只有首见年代为约数。planus 更深的印欧来源属重构，此处不作断言。

note.en: The first group holds words built on or resembling plan-; the second holds words for flat open country.
note.cn: 第一组是与 plan- 同源或形近的词；第二组是表示平坦开阔地区的词。

entries.definition: A flat surface, a tool or an aircraft; it comes from Latin planum and is related, but it never means open country or simple style.
entries.definitionCN: 平面、刨子或飞机；来自拉丁 planum，与 plain 相关，但从不表示开阔乡野或朴素风格。

entries.definition: A intended arrangement of future actions; the vowel is short /æ/, not long /eɪ/.
entries.definitionCN: 对未来行动的安排；元音是短音 /æ/，不是长音 /eɪ/。

entries.definition: To make something clear; Latin explanare is built on planus 'flat', so it shares the root but is not a derivative of the English plain.
entries.definitionCN: 把某事讲清楚；拉丁 explanare 建立在 planus「平的」上，因此同根，但不是英语 plain 的派生词。

entries.definition: A formal complaint or lament; it ends in -t and belongs to a different legal and literary family.
entries.definitionCN: 正式的申诉或哀诉；以 -t 结尾，属另一个法律与文学词族。

entries.definition: A large flat grassland, especially in North America; it stresses grass cover, while plain stresses flatness.
entries.definitionCN: 大片平坦草原，尤指北美；强调草被，而 plain 强调平坦。

entries.definition: A vast dry grass plain in Eurasia; it is a regional and ecological term, not a general one.
entries.definitionCN: 欧亚大陆广阔干旱的草原平原；它是区域性与生态学术语，不是一般词。

entries.definition: Land that is flat, used mainly in geography; it says only what plain already says.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦的陆地，主要用于地理学；它只是把 plain 已有的意思说出来。

entries.definition: A tropical grassland with scattered trees; it is defined by climate and vegetation, not by flatness.
entries.definitionCN: 散布树木的热带草原；它按气候与植被定义，而非平坦程度。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin planus root, the real compounds and the split between land and style.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁 planus 词根、真实的复合词，以及「土地」与「风格」两条义线。

normal.en: Latin planus 'flat' gives both the land and the style: flat ground, nothing added.
normal.cn: 拉丁 planus「平的」同时给出土地与风格：平地，以及没有附加。

normal.en: The family runs plain, plains, plainly, plainness, plainspoken.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 plain、plains、plainly、plainness、plainspoken。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: wide plain, plain English, plain clothes, flood plain.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 wide plain、plain English、plain clothes、flood plain。

normal.en: Explain shares the root planus 'flat': to explain is literally to make level.
normal.cn: explain 共享 planus「平的」词根：explain 字面上就是「使平」。

normal.en: Plain is flat; prairie is grassy; steppe is dry. Each picks a different feature.
normal.cn: plain 强调平，prairie 强调草，steppe 强调干旱；各取一个特征。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of paper laid on the ground, stretching to every horizon.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸铺在地上，一直伸到每一条地平线。

abstract.en: Picture a room with no pictures, no pattern and no colour but grey.
abstract.cn: 想象一个房间没有画、没有花纹，除了灰色没有别的颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence with no metaphor, no decoration and no hidden meaning.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话没有比喻、没有装饰，也没有隐藏的意思。

examples.en: The plain is used for wheat and cattle.
examples.cn: 这片平原用来种小麦和养牛。

examples.en: Please say it in plain language so everyone can follow.
examples.cn: 请用平实的语言说，让每个人都能听懂。

examples.en: The plain truth is that the plan will cost too much.
examples.cn: 明摆着的事实是，这个计划花费太高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普（pu）+ 兰（lan）」—— 普通又平坦、一眼看到边的大地 → 平原；朴素的

root: 拉丁 planus「平的、清楚的」→ 古法语 plain（形容词与名词）→ 英语 plain；名词义与形容词义同源合并。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split into two lines from one root: flat land on one side, and 'nothing added' on the other, giving simple, clear, honest, ordinary and basic.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个词根分成两条线：一边是平坦的土地，另一边是「没有附加」，由此得到朴素、清楚、直率、平常与简单。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surface with no rise and no added ornament, so nothing blocks the view.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个既没有隆起也没有附加装饰的表面，因此什么都挡不住视线。

branches.en: THE LAND: a flat stretch, and the plural that makes it a region.
branches.cn: 土地：一段平地，以及把它变成地区的复数。

branches.en: NOTHING ADDED: undecorated clothes, ordinary looks and plain food.
branches.cn: 没有附加：无装饰的衣服、平常的相貌与简单的食物。

branches.en: NO OBSTACLE: clear language is flat ground between speaker and listener.
branches.cn: 没有障碍：清楚的语言就是说话者与听者之间的平地。

branches.en: NO COVER: direct speech says exactly what is meant.
branches.cn: 没有遮盖：直率的话说的就是本意。

branches.en: SHEER FACT: what is obvious needs no argument, so plain intensifies.
branches.cn: 纯粹的事实：显而易见的东西无需论证，于是 plain 变成强调词。

intro.en: Plain is a Latin loan that serves as noun, adjective and adverb; English built a small family of compounds around its two sense lines.
intro.cn: plain 是拉丁借词，可作名词、形容词与副词；英语围绕它的两条义线造出一个小型复合词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin planus 'flat' and its noun planities 'level ground' supply the base; explanare 'to make clear' is a related verb, which is why explain shares the root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 planus「平的」及其名词 planities「平地」提供基础；动词 explanare「使清楚」与之相关，因此 explain 同根。

items.example: The stem plan- carries both flatness and clarity.
items.exampleCN: 词干 plan- 同时带有「平」与「清楚」两层。

items.structure: Old French plain, from Latin planus
items.example: The plain lies open to the north.
items.exampleCN: 这片平原向北敞开。

items.example: Dust storms cross the plains in spring.
items.exampleCN: 春天沙尘暴掠过平原地区。

items.example: Say it in plainer words.
items.exampleCN: 用更简单的话说。

items.example: The plainest answer is usually best.
items.exampleCN: 最直白的回答通常最好。

items.example: She plainly did not agree.
items.exampleCN: 她显然不同意。

items.example: The plainness of the room was deliberate.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间的朴素是刻意的。

items.example: A plainspoken neighbour warned us.
items.exampleCN: 一位直率的邻居提醒了我们。

items.meaning: flat land beside a river that floods
items.meaningCN: 河流旁边会被淹没的平地
items.example: The flood plain absorbs the spring melt.
items.exampleCN: 洪泛平原吸收春季融水。

items.meaning: to make clear, literally to make level
items.example: He explained the rule in one sentence.
items.exampleCN: 他用一句话解释了这个规则。

latinEntries.meaning: to make level; to make clear

definition_zh: 盆；洗脸盆；流域；盆地；船坞；水池
definition_en: a round open container; a washbowl; the land drained by a river; a low area surrounded by higher ground; a sheltered harbour for boats
core_image: 四周高、中间低的一只大碗，所有落下的水都向碗底汇合
scene: 四周的坡地向中间收拢，雨水最后都汇到最低的那片平地。The river basin collects water from four mountain slopes.
sceneCN: 此处指「由分水岭围出的整片汇水区域」（第 3 个义项：所有降水最终汇入同一水系的地区）；句意为这个流域从四面山坡收集雨水。图中可辨识物件：四周收拢的坡地、汇流的水线、最低处的平地、看不见的分水岭。

pos.zh: 盆；洗脸盆；流域；盆地；船坞；水池

senses.title: A round open container
senses.definition: a wide open container with sloping sides, used for holding liquid or solids
senses.definitionCN: 侧壁倾斜、开口宽大的容器，用来盛液体或固体
senses.example: She mixed the dough in a large basin.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一个大盆里和面。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a vessel: a bowl whose sides rise all round and whose middle is low.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项是容器：一只四边升高、中间低下的碗。

senses.title: A fixed washbowl
senses.definition: a bowl fixed under a tap for washing hands or face
senses.definitionCN: 固定在龙头下方、用来洗手或洗脸的盆
senses.example: The basin was full of cold water.
senses.exampleCN: 洗脸盆里装满了凉水。
senses.why: Household plumbing simply fixes the portable bowl in place; the shape and word stay the same.
senses.whyCN: 家用管道只是把可移动的盆固定住；形状与词都没有变。

senses.title: Land drained by one river
senses.definition: the whole area whose rain and streams drain into one river system
senses.definitionCN: 降水与溪流全部汇入同一水系的一整片地区
senses.example: The river basin collects water from four mountain slopes.
senses.exampleCN: 这个流域从四面山坡收集雨水。
senses.why: Rain falling on a bowl-shaped region runs to the lowest line, so the land behaves like a basin.
senses.whyCN: 落在碗状地区的雨水都流向最低的那条线，因此这片土地的行为就像一只盆。

senses.title: A low area ringed by higher ground
senses.definition: a broad lowland enclosed by hills or mountains
senses.definitionCN: 被丘陵或山地围住的宽阔低地
senses.example: The basin is dry for most of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 这个盆地一年中大部分时间都是干的。
senses.why: The landform is the container shape at landscape scale: higher edges, lower middle.
senses.whyCN: 这种地貌就是容器形状在地貌尺度上的放大：边缘高、中间低。

senses.title: A structural basin in geology
senses.definition: a rock formation in which layers dip inward toward a centre
senses.definitionCN: 岩层向中心倾斜的构造形态
senses.example: The basin holds oil in its deepest layers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个构造盆地在最深的岩层里储油。
senses.why: Geology reads the same bowl in the folding of rock layers, not in the surface.
senses.whyCN: 地质学在岩层的褶皱里读出同一只碗，而不是在地表上。

senses.title: A sheltered harbour for small boats
senses.definition: an enclosed area of water where small boats can be kept safely
senses.definitionCN: 可以安全停泊小船的一片围合水域
senses.example: Fishing boats returned to the basin before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 渔船在风暴前回到小船坞。
senses.why: A harbour enclosed by walls is a water bowl: high edges, protected low water.
senses.whyCN: 被墙围住的海港就是一只水碗：边缘高，中间是受保护的低水面。

senses.title: The water bowl of a fountain
senses.definition: the shallow container that holds the water of a fountain or cascade
senses.definitionCN: 承接喷泉或跌水水流的浅容器
senses.example: Coins lay at the bottom of the fountain basin.
senses.exampleCN: 硬币躺在喷泉水池的底部。
senses.why: The architectural sense is the literal vessel again, this time built into stone.
senses.whyCN: 建筑义又回到字面的容器，只是这次用石头砌成。

senses.title: Any bowl-shaped hollow
senses.definition: a hollow or depression with raised edges, natural or manufactured
senses.definitionCN: 边缘高、中间低的凹陷，天然或人造皆可
senses.example: Water had worn a shallow basin in the rock.
senses.exampleCN: 水在岩石上磨出一个浅盆状凹陷。
senses.why: The shape is the meaning: wherever edges rise around a low centre, the word applies.
senses.whyCN: 形状就是意义：凡是边缘围着低中心升起的，都适用这个词。

intro.en: Basin came from Old French bacin and probably goes back to a Late Latin vessel word of non-Latin, possibly Gaulish, origin. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: basin 来自古法语 bacin，可能上溯至一个非拉丁（或许高卢语）来源的晚期拉丁容器词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Late Latin baccinum, also written bacchinum, named a wide shallow vessel; it is recorded mainly in glosses and everyday vocabulary.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 baccinum（亦作 bacchinum）指宽而浅的容器；它主要见于词表与日常词汇。

items.en: The word is often traced to a Gaulish *bacca 'vessel', a reconstructed form; Latin may have borrowed it rather than inherited it.
items.cn: 这个词常被追溯到高卢语 *bacca「容器」，这是一个重构形式；拉丁语可能是借用而非继承。

items.en: Old French bacin meant 'basin, bowl'; its spelling with -in explains the English ending -in rather than -on.
items.cn: 古法语 bacin 意为「盆、碗」；-in 的拼写解释了英语为什么是 -in 结尾而不是 -on。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the thirteenth century for domestic vessels, then extended it to natural hollows and harbours.
items.cn: 英语在 13 世纪借入这个词指家用容器，随后扩展到天然凹陷与港湾。

items.en: The 'river basin' sense developed in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries with the rise of systematic hydrology and mapping.
items.cn: 「流域」义在 18 至 19 世纪随着系统水文学与地图绘制的发展而形成。

items.en: Source uncertain (root): the Gaulish origin is a hypothesis, no Latin etymon is certain, and the earliest dates are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根）：高卢语来源只是假说，没有确定的拉丁词源，最早年代为约数。

note.en: The first group holds words that look like basin or share its ending; the second holds words for low ground and drainage areas.
note.cn: 第一组是形近或共享词尾的词；第二组是表示低地与汇水区域的词。

entries.definition: The foundation or main principle of something; from Greek basis 'step, base', unrelated to the vessel word.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的基础或主要原则；来自希腊 basis「台阶、底座」，与容器词无关。

entries.definition: The bottom or support of something; it is a shorter, unrelated word from Greek and Latin basis.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的底部或支撑；是来自希腊与拉丁 basis 的较短词，与 basin 无关。

entries.definition: A low musical voice or a fish; the vowel differs and the word has no container sense.
entries.definitionCN: 低音或一种鱼；元音不同，且没有容器义。

entries.definition: An older variant spelling of basin, now rare; it is the same word, not a different one.
entries.definitionCN: basin 较早的异体拼写，现已罕用；它是同一个词，不是另一词。

entries.definition: A round deep dish for food; it is the everyday container, while basin often suggests a larger or fixed vessel.
entries.definitionCN: 盛食物的圆深盘；它是日常容器，而 basin 常指更大或固定的容器。

entries.definition: The ridge that separates two drainage areas; the basin is the land inside, the watershed is its edge.
entries.definitionCN: 分隔两个汇水区的山脊；basin 是里面的土地，watershed 是它的边缘。

entries.definition: A long low area between slopes; it is linear and open at one end, while a basin is enclosed all round.
entries.definitionCN: 坡面之间的长条低地；它是线性的、一端开口，而盆地四面围合。

entries.definition: Any sunken area, including economic and psychological senses; basin is the round, water-collecting version.
entries.definitionCN: 任何凹陷地区，也含经济与心理义；basin 是其中圆形、汇水的那一版。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real vessel source, the real hydrology terms and the shape that ties them together.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的容器来源、真实的水文学术语，以及把它们连起来的形状。

normal.en: One shape runs through the family: raised edges, low centre.
normal.cn: 一个形状贯穿整个词族：边缘高、中间低。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: river basin, drainage basin, wash basin, boat basin.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 river basin、drainage basin、wash basin、boat basin。

normal.en: A watershed is the rim of the basin; the basin is the land inside the rim.
normal.cn: 分水岭是盆的边沿；流域是边沿里面的土地。

normal.en: The geological basin folds rock layers into the same bowl.
normal.cn: 地质构造盆地把岩层褶成同一只碗。

normal.en: A harbour basin is a bowl of water protected by walls.
normal.cn: 港湾水域就是一只被墙保护的水碗。

abstract.en: Picture a bowl set in the ground so that every drop must roll to its centre.
abstract.cn: 想象一只碗嵌在地里，每一滴水都只能滚向中心。

abstract.en: Picture a stone hollowed by water until it holds a small pond.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头被水磨空，直到能盛住一个小水塘。

abstract.en: Picture a harbour whose walls turn the sea into a still bowl.
abstract.cn: 想象一个港口，墙把海面围成一只静止的碗。

examples.en: The Amazon basin covers millions of square kilometres.
examples.cn: 亚马孙流域覆盖数百万平方公里。

examples.en: He washed his hands in the basin by the door.
examples.cn: 他在门边的盆里洗手。

examples.en: The ocean basin is deeper than the surrounding shelf.
examples.cn: 这个海洋盆地比周围的大陆架更深。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「背（bei）+ 心（sin）」—— 四周高、背向中间低下去的一只大盆 → 盆；盆地；流域

root: 古法语 bacin「盆、碗」← 晚期拉丁 baccinum；更早来源可能是高卢语 *bacca「容器」，属重构且不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses repeat one vessel shape: a domestic bowl, a fixed washbowl, a river's drainage area, a lowland, a rock fold, a harbour, a fountain pool and any hollow.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项重复同一种容器形状：家用盆、固定洗脸盆、河流汇水区、低地、岩层褶皱、港湾、喷泉水池与任何凹陷。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bowl in the ground, its rim high and its centre low, gathering everything that falls.
core.cn: 核心意象：嵌在地里的一只碗，边沿高、中心低，收拢所有落下的东西。

branches.en: THE CONTAINER: a portable bowl, a fixed washbowl and a stone fountain pool.
branches.cn: 容器：可移动的盆、固定的洗脸盆与石砌喷泉水池。

branches.en: THE DRAINAGE: rain on a bowl-shaped region converges on one river.
branches.cn: 汇水：碗状地区上的雨水汇入同一条河。

branches.en: THE LANDFORM: a surface lowland and the folded rock beneath it.
branches.cn: 地貌：地表低地与其下褶皱的岩层。

branches.en: THE HARBOUR: walls make a bowl of still water for boats.
branches.cn: 港湾：墙围出一只静止的水碗供船停泊。

branches.en: THE GENERAL SHAPE: any hollow with raised edges qualifies.
branches.cn: 一般形状：任何边缘高起的凹陷都符合。

intro.en: Basin is a French loan with a compact English family; most new words are compounds naming a kind of basin.
intro.cn: basin 是法语借词，英语词族紧凑；新词多为命名某种盆或流域的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin baccinum is the earliest recoverable layer, and it may itself be a Gaulish loan; no secure native Latin root can be cited, so the deeper origin is left uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁 baccinum 是可追溯的最早层次，它本身可能是高卢语借词；无法给出可靠的拉丁本土词根，因此更深来源存疑。

items.structure: Old French bacin, from Late Latin baccinum
items.example: The basin is cracked along one edge.
items.exampleCN: 这只盆的一边裂了。

items.example: Two basins drain into the same river.
items.exampleCN: 两个流域汇入同一条河。

items.meaning: relating to a basin, especially in geology
items.meaningCN: 与盆地有关的，尤用于地质学
items.example: Basinal sediments are fine-grained.
items.exampleCN: 盆地沉积物颗粒细微。

items.example: Basinwide rules limit water use.
items.exampleCN: 全流域规则限制用水。

items.meaning: the land drained by a river
items.example: The river basin supports three cities.
items.exampleCN: 这个河流域养活着三座城市。

items.example: The drainage basin feeds the reservoir.
items.exampleCN: 这个集水区为水库供水。

items.example: The wash basin is beside the mirror.
items.exampleCN: 洗脸盆在镜子旁边。

items.example: The washbasin drains slowly.
items.exampleCN: 这个洗手盆排水很慢。

items.example: The boat basin is calm in all weather.
items.exampleCN: 这个小船坞在任何天气下都很平静。
