*bacca (reconstructed Gaulish word for a vessel, possibly borrowed into Latin)

definition_zh: 抑郁症；沮丧；经济萧条；低气压；洼地；凹陷；俯角
definition_en: a medical condition of low mood; a long economic slump; an area of low pressure; a sunken part of a surface; an angle below the horizontal
core_image: 一个表面被向下压，中间凹进去，四周仍保持原来的高度
scene: 订单连续几周没有增加，厂里的灯只开了一半。The long depression closed two factories in the town.
sceneCN: 此处指「持续多年的经济萧条」（第 3 个义项：生产与就业长期低迷的时期）；句意为这场漫长的萧条让镇上的两家工厂关门。图中可辨识物件：只开一半的厂房灯、停转的机器、紧闭的厂门、空荡的装卸区。

pos.zh: 抑郁症；沮丧情绪；经济萧条；低气压；洼地；凹陷；俯角

derivatives.zh: 沮丧的；被压低的；凹陷的

senses.title: A medical mood disorder
senses.definition: a clinical condition marked by persistent low mood, loss of interest and fatigue
senses.definitionCN: 以持续情绪低落、失去兴趣与疲乏为特征的临床状态
senses.example: She was treated for depression after the loss.
senses.exampleCN: 失去亲人之后，她接受了抑郁症治疗。
senses.why: The medical sense keeps the Latin image of being pressed down: mood is weighed down and cannot lift.
senses.whyCN: 医学义保留了拉丁语「被向下压」的意象：情绪被压住，抬不起来。

senses.title: A period of low mood
senses.definition: an ordinary spell of sadness or discouragement, not necessarily a diagnosis
senses.definitionCN: 一段普通的悲伤或灰心时期，未必构成诊断
senses.example: A short depression followed the bad news.
senses.exampleCN: 坏消息之后是一段短暂的情绪低落。
senses.why: Everyday speech uses the same downward pressure without the clinical meaning.
senses.whyCN: 日常说法使用同一个「向下压」的意象，但不带临床含义。

senses.title: A long economic slump
senses.definition: a prolonged period of falling output, high unemployment and low spending
senses.definitionCN: 产出下降、失业高企、消费低迷的长期时期
senses.example: The long depression closed two factories in the town.
senses.exampleCN: 这场漫长的萧条让镇上的两家工厂关门。
senses.why: Economic activity is pictured as a level that sinks; a deep and lasting sink is a depression.
senses.whyCN: 经济活动被画成一个下沉的水平面；沉得深而久，就是萧条。

senses.title: An area of low atmospheric pressure
senses.definition: a weather system with lower pressure than its surroundings, often bringing cloud and rain
senses.definitionCN: 气压低于周围、常带来云雨的系统
senses.example: A tropical depression formed over the warm sea.
senses.exampleCN: 一个热带低气压在温暖海面上形成。
senses.why: Meteorology draws pressure as height, so a low is literally a depression on the map.
senses.whyCN: 气象学把气压画成高度，因此低压在图上字面上就是一个凹陷。

senses.title: A sunken area of land
senses.definition: a hollow in the land, often one that collects water
senses.definitionCN: 地面上常积水的凹陷处
senses.example: Rainwater gathers in a shallow depression behind the house.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水积在屋后的一处浅洼地里。
senses.why: The literal shape returns: ground pressed down below its surroundings.
senses.whyCN: 字面的形状回来了：地面被压到周围之下。

senses.title: A hollow in a surface
senses.definition: a shallow dent or hollow in an object or a body part
senses.definitionCN: 物体或身体部位上的浅凹处
senses.example: The blade has a slight depression along its centre.
senses.exampleCN: 刀身中央有一道轻微的凹陷。
senses.why: Anything that is pressed inward shows the same profile at any scale.
senses.whyCN: 任何被向内压的东西，在任何尺度上都呈现同一轮廓。

senses.title: The act of pressing down
senses.definition: the action of lowering something or forcing it downward
senses.definitionCN: 把某物降低或向下压的动作
senses.example: The machine's depression of the lever starts the press.
senses.exampleCN: 机器把操纵杆压下，就启动了压机。
senses.why: The noun of action preserves the original verb: to press down.
senses.whyCN: 动作名词保留了原本的动词义：向下压。

senses.title: An angle below the horizon
senses.definition: the angle between the horizontal line of sight and a line looking downward
senses.definitionCN: 水平视线与向下视线之间的夹角
senses.example: The surveyor measured an angle of depression to the valley floor.
senses.exampleCN: 测量员量出了到谷底的俯角。
senses.why: Surveying describes looking down as a geometric drop, reusing the downward image.
senses.whyCN: 测量学把向下看描述成几何上的下落，重新使用了「向下」的意象。

intro.en: Depression comes from Latin depressio, from deprimere 'to press down', built on de- 'down' and premere 'to press'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: depression 来自拉丁 depressio，源于 deprimere「向下压」，由 de-「向下」与 premere「压」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin premere meant 'to press, squeeze'; its past participle pressus gives the stem seen in press, pressure and impress.
items.cn: 拉丁 premere 意为「压、挤」；其过去分词 pressus 给出见于 press、pressure 与 impress 的词干。

items.en: De- 'down' plus premere produced deprimere 'to press down, sink'; the noun depressio named a sinking or a low place.
items.cn: de-「向下」加 premere 产生 deprimere「向下压、使下沉」；名词 depressio 指下沉或低处。

items.en: Medieval and scientific Latin used depressio for physical sinking and for a low area of land or air.
items.cn: 中世纪与科学拉丁语用 depressio 指物理下沉，也指土地或空气的低区。

items.en: English adopted the word in the seventeenth century first for physical and astronomical lowering, then for economic slumps in the nineteenth.
items.cn: 英语在 17 世纪借入，最初指物理与天文上的降低，19 世纪转用于经济低迷。

items.en: The clinical mood sense is nineteenth-century psychiatry; earlier English used melancholy for the same condition.
items.cn: 临床情绪义属于 19 世纪精神病学；更早的英语用 melancholy 指同一状态。

items.en: The Latin root is secure; only the first date of each specialised sense is approximate. The pre-Latin origin of premere is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 拉丁词根可靠，只有各专门义项的首见年代为约数。premere 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构。

note.en: The first group holds words built on the same press- stem; the second holds words for economic slumps and sunken ground.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在同一 press- 词干上的词；第二组是表示经济低迷与凹陷地面的词。

entries.definition: To press down, lower or make sad; the noun depression is its action and state form.
entries.definitionCN: 向下压、降低或使悲伤；名词 depression 是它的动作与状态形式。

entries.definition: The act of squeezing something into less space; com- means 'together', so the pressing goes inward from all sides.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物压进更小空间的动作；com- 意为「一起」，所以是从各面向内压。

entries.definition: A mark pressed into a surface, or an effect on the mind; in- means 'into', so the image is pressing inward.
entries.definitionCN: 压入表面留下的痕迹，或对头脑的影响；in- 意为「向内」，意象是向内压。

entries.definition: The act of holding something back by force, or of keeping thoughts out of awareness; re- means 'back'.
entries.definitionCN: 用力量压住某事，或把想法排除在意识之外；re- 意为「向后」。

entries.definition: A period of temporary economic decline; it is shorter and milder than a depression, which is deep and prolonged.
entries.definitionCN: 暂时性的经济下滑期；比萧条更短更轻，而萧条是深而久的。

entries.definition: A sudden fall in sales, prices or activity; it is shorter and more sudden than a depression.
entries.definitionCN: 销售、价格或活动的突然下跌；比萧条更短更急。

entries.definition: A small sunken space in a surface; it is usually smaller and shallower than a depression in the land.
entries.definitionCN: 表面上小的凹陷空间；通常比地面上的洼地更小更浅。

entries.definition: A broad low area enclosed by higher ground; a depression is any sunken patch, while a basin is large and rimmed.
entries.definitionCN: 被高地围住的宽阔低地；depression 是任何凹陷处，basin 则大而有边沿。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real press- stem, the real compounds and the shared downward image.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的 press- 词干、真实的复合词，以及共同的「向下」意象。

normal.en: de- 'down' + premere 'press' = press down; the whole family is about pressure.
normal.cn: de-「向下」+ premere「压」= 向下压；整个词族都与压力有关。

normal.en: The family runs depress, depressed, depressing, depression, depressant.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 depress、depressed、depressing、depression、depressant。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: economic depression, suffer from depression, tropical depression, angle of depression.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 economic depression、suffer from depression、tropical depression、angle of depression。

normal.en: A graph of output that sinks and stays low is an economic depression.
normal.cn: 产出曲线下沉并保持低位的，就是经济萧条。

normal.en: A weather map draws low pressure as a dip, so a low is a depression.
normal.cn: 天气图把低压画成凹陷，所以低压就是一个 depression。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing a soft surface until the middle stays down.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把柔软的表面按下去，中间一直凹着。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp dimming slowly over many months.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯在好几个月里慢慢变暗。

abstract.en: Picture a line of sight tilting downward to meet a point on the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象一条视线向下倾斜，落到地面上的某一点。

examples.en: The Great Depression changed banking rules around the world.
examples.cn: 大萧条改变了世界各地的银行规则。

examples.en: A shallow depression in the field holds water after rain.
examples.cn: 雨后田里的浅洼地会积水。

examples.en: The doctor asked about symptoms of depression.
examples.cn: 医生询问了抑郁症的症状。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「低（di）+ 扑（pre）+ 神（ssion）」—— 整个人被低气压扑住，精神沉下去 → 抑郁；萧条；凹陷

root: 拉丁 deprimere「向下压」（de-「向下」+ premere「压」）→ 名词 depressio → 英语 depression。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe something pressed down: a mood, a diagnosis, an economy, air pressure, land, a surface, an action and an angle.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述被压下去的东西：情绪、诊断、经济、气压、土地、表面、动作与角度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surface pushed inward so that its middle sits below the rim.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个表面被向内推，中间低于边沿。

branches.en: THE MIND: clinical and everyday low mood both feel like being weighed down.
branches.cn: 心智：临床与日常的情绪低落都像被重物压住。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY: output sinks and stays low.
branches.cn: 经济：产出下沉并停在低处。

branches.en: THE AIR: low pressure is drawn as a dip on the map.
branches.cn: 空气：低气压在图上被画成凹陷。

branches.en: THE SURFACE: land and objects repeat the same sunken profile.
branches.cn: 表面：土地与物体重复同样的凹陷轮廓。

branches.en: THE ACTION AND ANGLE: pressing down, and the geometric angle of looking down.
branches.cn: 动作与角度：向下压，以及向下看的几何夹角。

intro.en: Depression is a Latin action noun; the de- and press- elements also build many other English words.
intro.cn: depression 是拉丁动作名词；de- 与 press- 两个成分也构成许多其他英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin premere 'to press' gives pressus and the noun depressio; de- 'down' marks the direction of the pressing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 premere「压」给出 pressus 与名词 depressio；de-「向下」标记压的方向。

items.example: The prefix marks a downward movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标记向下的运动。

items.example: Press the surface flat.
items.exampleCN: 把这个表面压平。

items.example: The lever depresses the spring.
items.exampleCN: 这根杠杆压下弹簧。

items.example: The depressed area holds water.
items.exampleCN: 这片低洼处积水。

items.example: The empty factory was a depressing sight.
items.exampleCN: 空荡的工厂是令人沮丧的景象。

items.meaning: a pressing down; a low state
items.example: The depression lasted six years.
items.exampleCN: 这场萧条持续了六年。

items.example: The clinic treats depressive illness.
items.exampleCN: 这家诊所治疗抑郁性疾病。

items.meaning: a substance that slows the nervous system
items.example: The drug is a mild depressant.
items.exampleCN: 这种药是一种温和的抑制剂。

items.example: Low pressure brings rain.
items.exampleCN: 低气压带来降雨。

definition_zh: 低地；低地区域；低海拔地带
definition_en: land that is lower than the country around it, especially flat land at low altitude
core_image: 四周地面较高，中间展开一大片接近海平面的平缓土地
scene: 河流在这里放慢，两岸展开成大片平坦的田地。Cattle graze on the lowland beside the river.
sceneCN: 此处指「海拔低、比周围地势更平坦的大片土地」（第 1 个义项：相对低落而平缓的地区）；句意为牛群在河边的低地上吃草。图中可辨识物件：放慢的河水、平坦田地、吃草的牛群、远处较高的坡。

pos.zh: 低地；低洼地区；（复数）低地区域
低地的（如 lowland rice、lowland forest）

senses.title: Land lower than its surroundings
senses.definition: ground that lies below the higher land around it
senses.definitionCN: 低于周围较高地面的土地
senses.example: Cattle graze on the lowland beside the river.
senses.exampleCN: 牛群在河边的低地上吃草。
senses.why: The compound is literal: low land. Height, not soil or climate, is what defines it.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词是字面的：低的土地。定义它的是高度，而不是土壤或气候。

senses.title: A region of low ground in the plural
senses.definition: the lowlands, used for a whole district of low ground
senses.definitionCN: 用复数指一整片低地构成的地区
senses.example: Most of the population lives in the lowlands.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分人口住在低地区域。
senses.why: The plural turns a stretch of low ground into a named region, contrasting with the highlands.
senses.whyCN: 复数把一段低地变成一个有名字的地区，与高地相对。

senses.title: The Scottish Lowlands
senses.definition: the southern and eastern part of Scotland, traditionally lower and more industrial
senses.definitionCN: 苏格兰南部与东部传统上更低、更工业化的地区
senses.example: The Lowlands have most of Scotland's farmland.
senses.exampleCN: 苏格兰低地拥有苏格兰大部分农田。
senses.why: A proper name fixes the general word to one region, with a capital letter.
senses.whyCN: 专有名词把这个一般词固定到某一个地区，并用大写标记。

senses.title: Low-altitude ground in geography
senses.titleCN: 地理学上的低海拔地带
senses.definition: land below a stated altitude, especially below the hill or mountain zone
senses.definitionCN: 低于某一海拔、尤其是低于丘陵或山区的土地
senses.example: Lowland habitats are warmer than the slopes above.
senses.exampleCN: 低地生境比上面的坡地更温暖。
senses.why: Ecology measures altitude, so lowland becomes a class of habitat rather than a single place.
senses.whyCN: 生态学测量海拔，于是低地成为一类生境，而不是某一个地方。

senses.title: Attributive: of the low country
senses.definition: used before a noun to mean the low-altitude version of something
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，表示某物的低海拔类型
senses.example: Lowland forest is taller and denser than mountain forest.
senses.exampleCN: 低地森林比山地森林更高更密。
senses.why: The noun marks the altitude band where the following thing grows or occurs.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词标出后面的事物生长或出现所处的海拔带。

senses.title: Flat land prone to flooding
senses.definition: low flat ground that water reaches first in heavy rain
senses.definitionCN: 大雨时最先被水淹到的低平地面
senses.example: The lowland floods every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这片低平地每年春天都被淹。
senses.why: Water finds the lowest ground, so lowland often implies flood risk.
senses.whyCN: 水总是找到最低的地面，因此这个词常隐含洪涝风险。

senses.title: The Low Countries in historical use
senses.definition: the low-lying coastal region of the Netherlands and Belgium, in older historical writing
senses.definitionCN: 荷兰与比利时沿海低洼地区，见于较早的历史写作
senses.example: Trade in the Low Countries grew rapidly in the fifteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 低地国家的贸易在 15 世纪迅速发展。
senses.why: The physical description became a political name for a region that shares the same low coast.
senses.whyCN: 这一地形描述变成了一片共享低海岸的地区的政治名称。

senses.title: Lowland identity or people
senses.titleCN: 低地居民；低地文化身份
senses.definition: the culture or people of a lowland region, contrasted with highlanders
senses.definitionCN: 低地地区的文化或居民，与高地人相对
senses.example: Lowland speech differs sharply from the upland dialects.
senses.exampleCN: 低地人的说话方式与高地方言差别很大。
senses.why: Where people live shapes how they speak, so the land word becomes a social label.
senses.whyCN: 人住在哪里会影响他们怎么说话，于是土地词变成社会标签。

intro.en: Lowland is a native English compound of low, from Old Norse lagr, and land, from Old English land. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: lowland 是英语本族复合词，由来自古诺尔斯语 lagr 的 low 与来自古英语 land 的 land 组合而成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Old English land meant 'land, country, territory'; it is a native Germanic word with relatives across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 古英语 land 意为「土地、国家、领地」；它是本土日耳曼词，在日耳曼语族中多有同族。

items.en: Old Norse lagr 'low' entered English in the Viking period and reinforced the native adjective low; the two forms merged.
items.cn: 古诺尔斯语 lagr「低的」在维京时期进入英语，强化了本土形容词 low；两种形式合并。

items.en: Middle English low meant 'not high, near the ground'; the compound lowland is recorded later, when regional contrasts needed a name.
items.cn: 中古英语 low 意为「不高、接近地面」；复合词 lowland 书证较晚，出现在需要命名地区性高低对比之时。

items.en: The Lowlands of Scotland and the Low Countries both fixed the word to named regions, one by internal contrast with the Highlands, the other by coastal altitude.
items.cn: 苏格兰低地与低地国家都把这个词固定到具体地区：前者靠与高地的内部对比，后者靠沿海海拔。

items.en: Modern geography and ecology use lowland as an altitude class, often defined in metres above sea level.
items.cn: 现代地理学与生态学把 lowland 用作海拔等级，常以海拔米数定义。

items.en: The elements are secure and native; only the first date of the compound is approximate. No Latin etymon exists for either element.
items.cn: 两个成分可靠且为本族词，只有复合词的首见年代为约数。两个成分都没有拉丁词源。

note.en: The first group holds words built on low or land; the second holds landform words for flat, low ground.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在 low 或 land 上的词；第二组是表示平坦低地的地貌词。

entries.definition: Land higher than its surroundings; it is the direct opposite in height, though both are formed the same way.
entries.definitionCN: 高于周围的地面；在高度上正相反，但构词方式相同。

entries.definition: A person from a lowland region; it adds -er to the same compound.
entries.definitionCN: 来自低地地区的人；是在同一复合词上加 -er。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning 'not high'; alone it describes height, not a region.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「不高」的形容词；单独使用时描述高度，而不是地区。

entries.definition: Solid ground or a country; it supplies the material that the first element qualifies.
entries.definitionCN: 坚实的土地或国家；它提供被前一个成分限定的材料。

entries.definition: Flat open country; it stresses lack of relief, while lowland stresses lower altitude.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦开阔的地区；强调缺少起伏，而 lowland 强调海拔较低。

entries.definition: Land that is flat, with no statement about height; a plateau can be flatland but not lowland.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦的土地，不涉及高度；高原可以是 flatland，但不是 lowland。

entries.definition: A low area ringed by higher ground; lowland may be open, a basin is enclosed.
entries.definitionCN: 被高地围住的低地；lowland 可以是敞开的，而盆地是围合的。

entries.definition: Low ground that is permanently wet; it adds water to the low position, which lowland does not require.
entries.definitionCN: 长期潮湿的低地；它在「低」之外加了「湿」，而 lowland 不要求湿。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two native elements, the real regional names and the altitude contrast.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个本族成分、真实的地区名称，以及海拔对比。

normal.en: low + land: literally 'low land'.
normal.cn: low + land：字面就是「低的土地」。

normal.en: The family runs lowland, lowlands, lowlander, lowland forest, lowland rice.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 lowland、lowlands、lowlander、lowland forest、lowland rice。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: lowland area, lowland plain, the lowlands.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 lowland area、lowland plain、the lowlands。

normal.en: Highland is the mirror compound: same structure, opposite height.
normal.cn: highland 是镜像复合词：结构相同，高度相反。

normal.en: The Scottish Lowlands and the Low Countries show the word fixed into proper names.
normal.cn: 苏格兰低地与低地国家显示了这个词如何固定为专名。

abstract.en: Picture a map where the brown high ground stops and green flat ground begins.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，褐色的高地停止，绿色的平地开始。

abstract.en: Picture water running downhill until it finds the flattest place to stop.
abstract.cn: 想象水一路向下，直到找到最平的地方停下来。

abstract.en: Picture two neighbours on a slope, one looking up at the other's house.
abstract.cn: 想象坡上的两户邻居，其中一户要抬头看另一户的房子。

examples.en: The lowland is drained by a network of small canals.
examples.cn: 这片低地由一张小运河网排水。

examples.en: Lowland farmers plant earlier than farmers in the hills.
examples.cn: 低地农民比山地农民播种更早。

examples.en: The railway follows the lowland all the way to the coast.
examples.cn: 铁路沿着低地一直延伸到海岸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「楼（lou）+ 兰（lan）+ 的（d）」—— 楼下的那片平地，比四周都低 → 低地

root: low（古诺尔斯语 lagr「低的」）+ land（古英语 land「土地」）→ 字面「低的土地」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all begin with ground below its surroundings, then extend to a region, a named district, an altitude class, a habitat label, flood-prone flats, a historical name and a social identity.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都从「低于周围的土地」出发，再扩展到一片地区、一个专名地区、一个海拔等级、一类生境、易涝平地、历史名称与社会身份。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a broad flat surface lying below the higher ground that surrounds it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片低于周围高地的宽阔平面。

branches.en: THE GROUND: a low stretch, and the plural that makes it a region.
branches.cn: 土地：一段低地，以及把它变成地区的复数。

branches.en: THE NAMES: Scotland's Lowlands and the Low Countries fix the word to real districts.
branches.cn: 名称：苏格兰低地与低地国家把这个词固定到真实地区。

branches.en: THE ALTITUDE BAND: ecology and geography use lowland as a class and a habitat label.
branches.cn: 海拔带：生态学与地理学把 lowland 用作类别与生境标签。

branches.en: THE WATER: the lowest ground floods first.
branches.cn: 水：最低的地面最先被淹。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE: where you live becomes who you are.
branches.cn: 人：住在哪里变成了「是谁」。

intro.en: Lowland is a transparent native compound; its family comes from the two elements and from compounds naming lowland crops and habitats.
intro.cn: lowland 是透明的本族复合词；词族来自两个成分，以及命名低地作物与生境的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Neither element has a Latin etymon: low is Germanic (reinforced by Old Norse) and land is native Old English, so the Latin entry list is empty by design.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都没有拉丁词源：low 属日耳曼语（受古诺尔斯语强化），land 是古英语本族词，因此拉丁条目按规则留空。

items.structure: Old Norse lagr 'low', merging with native Old English forms
items.example: The sun was low in the sky.
items.exampleCN: 太阳低低地挂在天上。

items.example: The land rises to the east.
items.exampleCN: 土地向东升高。

items.example: The lowland is fertile.
items.exampleCN: 这片低地很肥沃。

items.example: The lowlands hold most of the farms.
items.exampleCN: 低地区域集中了大部分农场。

items.example: A lowlander showed us the road.
items.exampleCN: 一位低地居民给我们指了路。

items.meaning: rice grown on flooded flat fields
items.meaningCN: 在淹水平田里种植的水稻
items.example: Lowland rice needs standing water.
items.exampleCN: 低地稻需要蓄水。

items.example: Lowland forest is tall and dense.
items.exampleCN: 低地森林高大茂密。

items.example: The road climbs from lowland to highland.
items.exampleCN: 公路从低地爬升到高地。

definition_zh: 高地；高地区域；高地地带；山地牧场
definition_en: land that is higher than the country around it, especially a cool, hilly region used for grazing
core_image: 地面整体被抬高，形成一片起伏的草坡，风从坡顶掠过
scene: 云层贴着草坡移动，风比谷底冷得多。Sheep graze on the highland above the village.
sceneCN: 此处指「高于周围、气候较冷的高处土地」（第 1 个义项：整体抬升的起伏地带）；句意为羊群在村子上方的高地上吃草。图中可辨识物件：贴坡移动的云、起伏草坡、羊群、谷底与高处的温差。

pos.zh: 高地；高地区域；（复数）高地地带
高地的（如 highland cattle、highland village）

senses.title: Land higher than its surroundings
senses.definition: ground that stands above the lower country around it
senses.definitionCN: 高出周围低地的地面
senses.example: Sheep graze on the highland above the village.
senses.exampleCN: 羊群在村子上方的高地上吃草。
senses.why: The compound is literal: high land. The defining feature is relative height, not rock or climate.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词是字面的：高的土地。定义特征是相对高度，而不是岩石或气候。

senses.title: A highland region in the plural
senses.definition: the highlands, used for a whole tract of elevated country
senses.definitionCN: 用复数指一整片抬高的地区
senses.example: Rain falls more heavily in the highlands.
senses.exampleCN: 高地区域的降雨更多。
senses.why: The plural turns elevated ground into a named region, the counterpart of the lowlands.
senses.whyCN: 复数把抬高的地面变成一个有名字的地区，与「低地」一词相对。

senses.title: The Scottish Highlands
senses.definition: the mountainous northern and western part of Scotland, with a distinct culture and history
senses.definitionCN: 苏格兰北部与西部的山地地区，有独特的文化与历史
senses.example: The Highlands are famous for deep valleys and bare ridges.
senses.exampleCN: 苏格兰高地以深谷与裸露山脊闻名。
senses.why: A capitalised proper name fixes the general word to one famous region.
senses.whyCN: 带大写的专名把这个一般词固定到一个著名的地区。

senses.title: A high-altitude ecological zone
senses.definition: the belt of land above the surrounding lowland, with cooler climate and different vegetation
senses.definitionCN: 位于周围低地之上、气候更冷、植被不同的地带
senses.example: Highland plants grow low to escape the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 高地植物贴地生长以躲避风。
senses.why: Ecology turns relative height into a measurable zone with its own species and climate.
senses.whyCN: 生态学把相对高度变成一个有自身物种与气候的可测量地带。

senses.title: Attributive: of the high country
senses.definition: used before a noun for the highland version of a thing, breed or place
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，表示某物、某品种或某地的高地类型
senses.example: Highland cattle have long hair and broad horns.
senses.exampleCN: 高地牛有长毛和宽角。
senses.why: The noun marks the altitude band where the following thing belongs.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词标出后面事物所属的海拔带。

senses.title: Hill pasture used for grazing
senses.definition: rough elevated grassland used for sheep or cattle in summer
senses.definitionCN: 夏季用来放羊或放牛的粗放高地草场
senses.example: The highland is open to grazing from May to October.
senses.exampleCN: 这片高地牧场从五月到十月开放放牧。
senses.why: People use the word for the land's economic role, not only its height.
senses.whyCN: 人们用这个词指土地的经济角色，而不只是它的高度。

senses.title: Highland people and culture
senses.definition: the communities and traditions of a highland region, contrasted with lowland society
senses.definitionCN: 高地地区的社群与传统，与低地社会相对
senses.example: Highland music travelled far beyond the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 高地音乐传到了群山之外很远的地方。
senses.why: A shared landscape produces shared customs, so the land word becomes a cultural label.
senses.whyCN: 共同的地貌产生共同的习俗，于是土地词变成文化标签。

senses.title: The highland side of a contrast
senses.definition: the elevated half of a regional highland-lowland division, used as a general concept
senses.definitionCN: 地区性高低二分中抬高的那一半，用作一般概念
senses.example: The highland and lowland economies depend on each other.
senses.exampleCN: 高地与低地经济彼此依赖。
senses.why: Once a region is divided by height, each half becomes a category that planners and historians can name.
senses.whyCN: 一片地区一旦按高度划分，每一半都成为规划者与历史学家可以命名的类别。

intro.en: Highland is a native English compound of high, from Old English hēah, and land. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: highland 是英语本族复合词，由来自古英语 hēah 的 high 与 land 组合而成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Old English hēah meant 'high, tall, exalted'; it is the native adjective behind modern high.
items.cn: 古英语 hēah 意为「高的、高大的、尊贵的」；它是现代 high 背后的本族形容词。

items.en: Old English land meant 'land, country, territory', a native Germanic word shared across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 古英语 land 意为「土地、国家、领地」，是日耳曼语族共有的本土词。

items.en: Middle English high and land were both common; the compound highland appears later, when regional height contrasts needed a fixed term.
items.cn: 中古英语 high 与 land 都已常用；复合词 highland 出现较晚，是在地区高度对比需要固定说法之时。

items.en: The capitalised Highlands became the standard name for the Scottish uplands, especially after the eighteenth-century romantic interest in mountain scenery.
items.cn: 带大写的 Highlands 成为苏格兰高地的标准名称，尤其在 18 世纪对山地风景的浪漫兴趣兴起之后。

items.en: Modern geography uses highland as an altitude and relief class, often paired with lowland in regional descriptions.
items.cn: 现代地理学把 highland 用作海拔与起伏等级，常与 lowland 配对使用于区域描述。

items.en: Both elements are secure and native; only the first date of the compound is approximate. Neither element has a Latin etymon.
items.cn: 两个成分都可靠且为本族词，只有复合词的首见年代为约数。两个成分都没有拉丁词源。

note.en: The first group holds words built on high or land; the second holds words for elevated country.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在 high 或 land 上的词；第二组是表示抬高地区的词。

entries.definition: Land lower than its surroundings; the direct height opposite, built the same way.
entries.definitionCN: 低于周围的地面；在高度上正相反，构词方式相同。

entries.definition: A person from a highland region; it adds -er to the same compound.
entries.definitionCN: 来自高地地区的人；是在同一复合词上加 -er。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning 'tall or elevated'; alone it describes height, not a region.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「高的、抬高的」形容词；单独使用时描述高度，而不是地区。

entries.definition: The plural of highland; it can also be a proper name for a specific region.
entries.definitionCN: highland 的复数；也可作为某一具体地区的专名。

entries.definition: Land higher than the nearby valleys; it is more neutral and less tied to a named region than highland.
entries.definitionCN: 高于附近谷地的土地；比 highland 更中性，也更少绑定某一具名地区。

entries.definition: A high area with a flat top; highland may be rolling, but a plateau specifically insists on flatness.
entries.definitionCN: 顶部平坦的高地；highland 可以是起伏的，而高原特别强调平坦。

entries.definition: Open rough upland, often peaty and wet; it adds vegetation and soil to the height.
entries.definitionCN: 开阔粗放的高地，常含泥炭且潮湿；它在高度之外加了植被与土壤。

entries.definition: A broad flat elevated region; it describes the shape directly, while highland describes relative position.
entries.definitionCN: 宽阔平坦的高地；直接描述形状，而 highland 描述相对位置。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two native elements, the real proper name and the altitude contrast with lowland.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个本族成分、真实的专名，以及与 lowland 的海拔对比。

normal.en: high + land: literally 'high land'.
normal.cn: high + land：字面就是「高的土地」。

normal.en: The family runs highland, highlands, highlander, highland cattle, highland fling.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 highland、highlands、highlander、highland cattle、highland fling。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: highland area, highland region, highland village, highland climate.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 highland area、highland region、highland village、highland climate。

normal.en: Lowland is the mirror compound: same structure, opposite height.
normal.cn: lowland 是镜像复合词：结构相同，高度相反。

normal.en: The Highlands capitalises the word for Scotland's uplands.
normal.cn: The Highlands 用大写把这个词固定为苏格兰高地。

abstract.en: Picture a green blanket lifted at one end so that it slopes upward.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绿色毯子一端被提起，于是向上倾斜。

abstract.en: Picture clouds dragging along a slope instead of floating above it.
abstract.cn: 想象云层沿着坡面拖行，而不是飘在上方。

abstract.en: Picture two maps of the same country, one shaded brown at the top and one green at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个国家的两张地图，一张顶部染褐，一张底部染绿。

examples.en: The highland receives more rain than the coast.
examples.cn: 高地比海岸得到更多降雨。

examples.en: Highland roads close when snow blocks the passes.
examples.cn: 大雪封住山口时，高地公路会封闭。

examples.en: Many Highlanders left for the cities in the nineteenth century.
examples.cn: 19 世纪，许多高地居民迁往城市。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「嗨（hai）+ 兰（lan）+ 的（d）」—— 嗨到高处的草地，风大又冷 → 高地

root: high（古英语 hēah「高的」）+ land（古英语 land「土地」）→ 字面「高的土地」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all begin with ground above its surroundings, then extend to a region, a famous proper name, an ecological belt, a habitat label, pasture, a culture and one half of a regional contrast.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都从「高于周围的地面」出发，再扩展到一片地区、一个著名专名、一条生态带、一类生境、牧场、一种文化，以及地区对比中的一半。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rolling surface lifted above the valleys, colder and windier than the ground below.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片被抬到谷地之上的起伏地面，比下方更冷、风更大。

branches.en: THE GROUND: a raised stretch, and the plural that makes it a region.
branches.cn: 土地：一段抬高的地面，以及把它变成地区的复数。

branches.en: THE NAME: the Highlands fixes the word to Scotland's uplands.
branches.cn: 名称：The Highlands 把这个词固定为苏格兰高地。

branches.en: THE BELT: altitude creates a zone with its own plants, breeds and weather.
branches.cn: 地带：海拔造出一个拥有自身植物、品种与天气的区域。

branches.en: THE PASTURE: the land's use as summer grazing.
branches.cn: 牧场：这片土地作为夏季放牧之用的角色。

branches.en: THE PEOPLE AND THE DIVISION: shared height makes shared culture and a regional half.
branches.cn: 人与划分：共同的高度造就共同的文化，也构成地区的一半。

intro.en: Highland is a transparent native compound; its family comes from the two elements and from names of highland breeds, dances and places.
intro.cn: highland 是透明的本族复合词；词族来自两个成分，以及高地品种、舞蹈与地名。

latinIntro.en: Neither element has a Latin etymon: high is native Old English hēah and land is Old English land, so the Latin entry list is empty by design.
latinIntro.cn: 两个成分都没有拉丁词源：high 是古英语本族词 hēah，land 是古英语 land，因此拉丁条目按规则留空。

items.example: The wall is two metres high.
items.exampleCN: 这堵墙有两米高。

items.example: The land rises toward the north.
items.exampleCN: 土地向北升高。

items.example: The highland is cool even in summer.
items.exampleCN: 这片高地夏天也很凉。

items.example: The highlands feed the main rivers.
items.exampleCN: 高地区域为主要的河流供水。

items.example: A highlander guided the group.
items.exampleCN: 一位高地居民给队伍带路。

items.meaning: a hardy breed with long hair
items.example: Highland cattle winter outdoors.
items.exampleCN: 高地牛在户外过冬。

items.meaningCN: 一种活泼的苏格兰独舞
items.example: The highland fling ends the evening.
items.exampleCN: 高地弗林舞为夜晚收尾。

items.meaning: the cooler, wetter climate of high ground
items.example: The highland climate suits sheep.
items.exampleCN: 高地气候适合养羊。

items.example: The road drops from highland to lowland.
items.exampleCN: 公路从高地下降到低地。
